notes: Raw printed text only. Mapping to effects happens later (PLAN T2.1/T2.2).
The bounty deck contains 9 bounty cards and 2 'Wanted' job cards (images 09 and 10, same text, different flavor and patrol).
Bounty class: color and pips agree (white 1, green 2, yellow 3, orange 4 [UB]); class is shown by the portrait frame and the pips under it.
Bold text inside a paragraph is written between ** **; labelled fields have no label.

cards.name: Wanted
cards.flavor: You see a familiar name on the bounty board. It seems that they have crossed the wrong people.
cards.destination: A space containing another player that has at least 1 {REP_NEG} reputation.
cards.encounter: Resolve a combat against that player. If you win, claim this reward.
cards.reward: If you won combat against a player who has more fame than you, gain {CREDITS}5,000 and 2 fame. Otherwise, gain {CREDITS}5,000 and 1 fame. Then discard this card.
